BEAM_DEFINITION.DEDUPLICATION: children are sets; the first expansion that reaches a set keeps it
BEAM_DEFINITION.EXPANSION: for every retained partial state S, score all 13,983,816 legal tickets exactly against R + S (the reused global residual scorer) and take the 8 legal tickets of largest conditional marginal, ties to the lexicographically lowest ticket; tickets already in R + S are not legal
BEAM_DEFINITION.RETENTION: keep 8 states by exact union coverage of R + S descending, then the lowest canonical state identity (replacement tickets sorted within and across tickets)

BEAM_STATES_DEFINITION: GENERATED: children produced before deduplication; UNIQUE: distinct child sets per depth; RETAINED: states kept by the beam, summed over depths 1..D (the empty root state excluded)
CONDITIONAL_ENUMERATIONS_DEFINITION: complete ticket-universe scorings in the pilot (one per retained state per depth, the empty depth-0 state included); parity-gate enumerations are counted in PARITY
INTERACTION_AWARE_FINDING_RULE: ESTABLISHED only if the winner uses a ticket outside the one-shot global top 48 of its destroy set AND BEST_COUNT > START_COUNT AND the canonical recount passes
NOT_CLAIMED: optimality of any beam state (BEAM_WIDTH = 8 and 8 children per state are heuristic bounds)
superiority or equality relative to protected Lane 3
PEAK_MEMORY_DEFINITION: ru_maxrss of the single pilot process (one worker, no children)

REUSE.CHANGED_MECHANISM: candidate generation only (one-shot top 48 -> conditional beam)

TIE_BREAK: within a beam: coverage, then lowest canonical state identity; across destroy sets: max exact count, then lowest normalized portfolio sha256
